entities.name: Akinwunmi Isola
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Akinwumi Isola was a Yoruba playwright, novelist, actor, dramatist, culture activist and scholar. He was known for his writing in, and his work in promoting, the Yoruba language. As an actor, he was known for;Agogo Eèwò (2002) as Ifa Priest
Sawo-Segberi (2005)
The Campus Queen (2004) as Professor
Thunderbolt: Magun (2001) as Professor
Brass Bells (1999) as Babalawo
Efunsetan Aniwura (1981)
Efunsetan Aniwura (2005).
